sources.entry: BugPin - Visual bug reporting and ticketing tool for web applications. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0/MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: BugPin is a self-hosted, open-source visual bug reporting tool that captures annotated screenshots and tracks bugs from web applications.
summary.what_it_does: Provides an embeddable widget that lets end users capture screenshots of any page, annotate them with pen, shapes, arrows, text, and privacy blur, and submit reports. Reports are cached locally when offline and synced when the connection returns. Automatically collects failed network requests (4xx, 5xx), console errors, and OS/browser/device info. An admin console lets you create projects (each with its own API key), triage reports, and use light or dark mode. Reports can be exported as Markdown, plain text, an AI prompt, or JSON, and forwarded to GitHub Issues. Security options include domain whitelists, configurable rate limiting, HSTS, and secure headers.
use_cases: collect visual bug reports from website users
annotate screenshots of web app issues
track and triage bugs for multiple projects
forward bug reports to GitHub Issues
self-host a bug reporting tool with data on own servers
export bug diagnostics for AI-assisted debugging
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml with image registry.arantic.cloud/bugpin/bugpin:latest, port 7300:7300, and volume ./data:/data
Or run: docker run -d --name bugpin -p 7300:7300 -v bugpin-data:/data registry.arantic.cloud/bugpin/bugpin:latest
Log in to the admin console with the default credentials and change the password immediately
Create a project in the Projects section and copy its API key
Add the widget via a script tag with the API key, or install @arantic/bugpin-widget via npm and call BugPin.init with apiKey and serverUrl
notable: Widget embeds via a single script tag and works with React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, or vanilla JS
Shadow DOM isolation keeps widget styles from leaking into the host site
Widget translated into 8 languages with automatic detection
Multi-license: AGPL-3.0 for server and admin console, MIT for widget
Export diagnostics with section toggles and redactions
caveats: Enterprise Edition features are proprietary and covered by a separate BugPin Business License
Default admin credentials must be changed after first login
Full documentation is hosted externally at docs.bugpin.io
